WARFRAMEMOD-ENABLE_MULTIPLAYER_REBALANCE:
Make all enemies prevent several [gold]Stun[/gold] in each turn to match the difficulty in singleplayer games.
It is not recommended to enable this option when there is more than one [gold]Volt[/gold] among the players.
WARFRAMEMOD-REPLACE_PRISMATIC_GEM.title: Replace Prismatic Gem with Sea Glass
Whether [gold]Prismatic Gem[/gold] is replaced with [gold]Sea Glass[/gold] when you are playing a [gold]Warframe[/gold].
Since [gold]Prismatic Gem[/gold] can significantly reduce the difficulty of the game, it is recommended to try enabling this option.
